investment_theses.thesis: Rising Treasury yields (>4.5%) and 'something always breaks' macro conditions will drive safe-haven demand into Bitcoin and gold, pushing BTC/DXY ratio higher despite dollar strength.
supporting_signals: CNBC: 10-year Treasury yields at multi-year highs; historical pattern warns of financial calamity
Trump-Xi summit produced no tariff/trade relief; geopolitical uncertainty rising
Iran-U.S. Strait of Hormuz talks 'constructive'—oil/risk premium unresolved
investment_theses.counter_view: If Fed cuts rates aggressively or Trump-Xi talks yield surprise trade accord, risk-on rotation could sell BTC and favor equities; dollar strength could weaken BTC/DXY despite nominal BTC gains.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC perps, short DXY futures or long BTC/DXY ratio; hedge with long gold (GLD) for tail risk confirmation.

investment_theses.thesis: Hester Peirce's imminent departure removes the SEC's top crypto advocate; her replacement is likely to adopt a stricter stance, delaying or blocking spot Bitcoin derivatives and staking infrastructure approvals.

Blockchain Association leadership also shifting after CLARITY vote failure
SEC Commissioner turnover creates regulatory vacuum in crypto policy
investment_theses.counter_view: Replacement could be crypto-neutral pragmatist; Trump administration may push for pro-crypto stance at SEC via leadership pressure; ETF approval momentum already priced in.
investment_theses.expression: Short ETH/BTC ratio (expect relative underperformance of AI/smart-contract narratives vs. macro BTC rally); or pairs trade: long BTC spot ETF, short Ethereum options (sell near-dated calls).

investment_theses.thesis: Ethena (ENA), Ondo (ONDO), and NEAR Protocol will benefit from increased institutional yield-seeking as Ethereum staking APY rises and USDC lending rates recover post-Peirce-exit regulatory shift.

Peirce departure signals future tightness on yield infrastructure; current rates attractive relative to future options
Circle/Tether stablecoin freeze response on Bitget hack shows institutional custody focus rising
investment_theses.counter_view: Regulatory crackdown on yield products post-Peirce; staking derivatives face CFTC scrutiny; broader crypto downturn could reverse alt-season momentum.
investment_theses.expression: Long ENA/ETH and ONDO/ETH pairs; or structured: 60% NEAR spot, 40% USDC yield via lending (Compound, Aave) for hedged yield capture.

Kalshi sports contracts now explicitly subject to state regulation; platform viability threatened
